description: Return the practice change feed for one state, ranked as on the ProviderSignal dashboard: new practice registrations, new associates and specialists, moves and departures, DSO affiliation changes, license and disciplinary events. Each row has the type's key and label, the labels about_to_open and new_to_territory, a date (a movement's own day; for a board signal, the day it was detected), the practice, address, NPI, a one-line reason and the verified website. The window is 7 days by default and 90 at most. Rows from the national registry (new practices, new associates, new locations) arrive in batches days to weeks apart, so a 7-day window may hold none: ask days 30 to be sure of the newest. meta.by_type counts rows per type, and meta.scan says for movements and for board events whether the window was read in full. Requires a Bearer token on API Pro or Enterprise; without one the newest 30 days are paid per call over HTTP.

days.description: Trailing window in days (default 7, 90 at most).

state.description: Two-letter state code or DC, or the state's name (e.g. TX). Required.

types.description: Types to keep, as meta.by_type names them: for example new_practice, dso_acquisition, provider_moved, disciplinary_action, status_change, the labels about_to_open and new_to_territory, and the rollups expiration_approaching and routine_renewal. A list, or one comma-separated string.

name: get_practice_triggers
